stemMd: A business has fixed cost 360 units and variable cost 8 per item. It sells each item for 14. How many items must it sell to break even?
explanationMd: Each sale contributes 14−8=6 towards fixed cost. Break-even occurs at 360/6=60 items, where revenue and total cost both equal 840.

distractorRationale.a: This divides by selling price and rounds improperly.
distractorRationale.b: This divides fixed cost by variable cost rather than contribution margin.
distractorRationale.d: This uses a margin of 5 instead of 6.
